text:
Maya Chen: quick heads-up — we're scheduling a micro-canary for qL6B-int4 tomorrow 09:00PT. Need curation lead + golden additions before rollout.
Liam Patel: noted. what's the sampling plan for prompts? we should avoid top-heavy webnoise.
Maya Chen: good call. target = 2.5k prompts, stratified by intent+len (short/med/long). dedupe threshold 0.92 semsim. save sample to `golden-additions/ql6b_micracanary_0321.csv`.
Olga Sokolov: I'll run dedupe pipeline tonight. remind me: use new tokenizer-v2 fingerprinting, right?
Jun Park: yes — tokenizer-v2 + fuzzyhash fallback. I'll push a one-off job: `./scripts/sample_for_canary --cohort micro7 --count 2500 --dedupe 0.92 --tokenizer v2`
Maya Chen: perfect. also need labeler routing: mark these with tag `quant-microcanary-0321` and priority high. @LabelerBot can you create 80 label tasks and round-robin to the quant QA pool? :robot_face:
LabelerBot: created 80 tasks, pool=quant-qa, TTL=48h, tag=quant-microcanary-0321.
Liam Patel: for evaluation, let's run the new metric suite (consistency, instruction-following, hallucination-rate) + token-efficiency delta vs qL6B-fp16. Can we get a baseline run?
André Gomez: I'll launch the bench job after the sample is ready. FYI I saw an odd regression in similarity recall when we tried int4 on qL6B on long contexts — might need kv-cache tuning.
Maya Chen: noted. add a micro-test for longctx (>=2048) with 200 examples. If recall drops >5% we should auto-fallback to qL6B-fp16.
ci-deploy: deploy triggered: canary group=micro7, model=qL6B-int4, variant=ql6b-int4-v1, route=eng-ml-us, start=2026-03-22T16:00:00Z
Olga Sokolov: dedupe run finished — ~2.6k raw -> 2.48k after dedupe. I pushed `golden-additions/ql6b_micracanary_0321.csv` and a small manifest `manifest_ql6b_micro7.json` to s3.
Jun Park: sampling and manifest acked. starting labeler attach script now.
Liam Patel: once labels are back, I'll run the eval harness. snippet I'll use:```bash
python eval_harness/run.py --model ql6b-int4-v1 --dataset s3://redwood/golden-additions/ql6b_micracanary_0321.csv --metrics consistency,hallucination,efficiency --out results/ql6b_int4_micro7.json
```
Maya Chen: if any metric regresses >3% vs baseline, flag the rollout and revert traffic to ql6b-fp16. set alert channel to #eng-runtime and tag @André Gomez.
André Gomez: will do — I'll add an automated fallback monitor that watches the three metrics and the longctx recall.
LabelerBot: 23/80 tasks completed. average label latency ~= 6.2h.
Liam Patel: FYI we should also run a small adversarial prompt set (10 tricky prompts) from `probes/longctx-hallucination.json` before routing 10% traffic.
Maya Chen: agree. plan: 24h label window, eval run, adversarial probes, then 10% traffic for 2h, monitor. If all green -> 50% then steady. Any objections?
Olga Sokolov: none. I'll keep an eye on dedupe false-positives; found one paraphrase cluster that merged distinct intents earlier, fixed rule.
Jun Park: logging patch to include kv-cache hit rate in traces is in PR #5123. canary will pick it up.
ci-deploy: canary live in 10m (dry-run), monitoring hooks enabled.
Maya Chen: thanks everyone — I'll post a short status update in #eng-ml after the first evaluation completes. :rocket:
